div.l: That crystis gospellis trewly wold preche
Hys parishons deuoutyly wolde he teche
Benygne he was and wonder dylygent
And in aduersite ful pacient
And suche he was proued ofte sithes
Ful loth were he to curse for hys tithys
But Rathyr wold he yeue out of doute
Vnto hys poure parishons aboute
Of hys offryng and eke of hys substaunce
He ceude in lityl thyng haue suffysaunce
Wyde was his parysshe ⁊and housis fer a sondir
But he let not for rayn ne for thundyr
In siknesse ner in myschyef to vysite
The ferrest in hys parish more and lite
Vp on hys feet and in hys hond a staf
Thys nobyl ensample vnto hys sheep he yaf
That first he wroughte ⁊and aftirward taught
Ouf of the gospell the wordys he caught
And thys figure he ekyd therto
That yf gold ruste what shold Iren do
For a preest to be foul in whom we truste
No wonder is a lewd man to ruste
And shame it is yf a preest take kepe
A slotty shepherde and a clene shepe
Wel oughte a preest ensample to gyue
Be hys clennesse how hys sheep shold lyue
Be sette not hys benefyce to hyre
And lete hys sheep acombre in the myre
And renne to London to saynt Poulis
And seke hym a chauntrye for soulis
Othyr wyth a bretherhede to be wythholde
But duelle at hoom and kepe hys folde
So that the wolf ne made it not myscarye
He was a sheepherde and not a mercenarye
And though he holy were and vertuous
He was nat to synfulmen to despytous
Ne of hys techyng daungerous ne dygne
But in hys speche dyscrete and benygne
